items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain financial containment. Do not authorize new spend, paid acquisition, production expansion, or new monetization work this cycle. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, while revenue support is weak: Amazon reported 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21; all commission is in aggregate tracking ID other, so site revenue and ROI are unsupported. AI usage cost was $1,002.46 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30 across 5,531 calls, including 234 errors, but it cannot be compared directly with the single-day revenue window. Infrastructure, domain, hosting, labor, and other operating costs are not present, so contribution margin, payback, budget exposure, and total cost-to-learn are not calculable. Preserve existing measurement and repair work; admit no new work until one slot is released and financial attribution evidence improves.

Financial disposition: treat all revenue forecasts, site-level ROI claims, contribution-margin claims, and causal-lift claims as unsupported. The available evidence supports only $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21 and $0 site-attributed income; the aggregate row cannot be assigned to sites without inventing attribution. Monthly AI spend is $1,002.46 for September, but infrastructure and other costs are unknown. Minimum evidence for a finance-grade decision is a period-matched ledger by site and content identifier covering affiliate clicks, ordered and shipped items, commission, AI cost, infrastructure/hosting, domains, and any paid marketing or labor allocation.
